Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Shows administrative divisions. "Published by the executors of Dr. William Douglas of Boston in New England, from his original draught." "Engraved by R. W. Seale." Includes inset of "Casco Bay" area. Scale ca. 1:316,800. Library of Congress.
